review.content:
We ordered the wall bed for my son’s bedroom which is the box room. Whilst there was a slight delay with the delivery, the team at Arthauss were very quick to respond and made sure that they did everything they could to get the item out to us as soon as it was in stock, Hubert was very quick to respond on email. The tracking information we received was helpful and accurate.
The delivery arrived exactly on time within our 1hr slot, the driver was friendly and brought the delivery into the house...

review.content: I have wanted one of these for years to save space. Other reviews said it took them days to build, hard to read instructions etc. Well I couldn’t disagree more. I have been building flat pack furniture for years and done it for a job. This was very simple to do. The instructions aren’t English but the pictures are so easy to follow and understand. It took me and my son 5 hours to build. Inexperienced people if you take your time and keep organised it shouldn’t take anymore than 8 hours for two ...

review.content: Very good quality piece of furniture. Takes a while to build, but once done it is very sturdy. review.content:
The bed & wardrobes look fantastic and very sturdy. Lovely Matt finish (not a fan of gloss).
Similar to other reviews, assembly was not easy as picture instructions only and none of the parts are numbered / labelled. Video tutorial helped a bit but parts were different as not for this specific. Comes in 5 heavy boxes so have to take it all out to try and work out what goes where.
If instructions were better and parts labelled, would have given it a "love it" rating

Already recommended to friends ;)

review.content: Delivery was early because they saw the lights on. Delivered at 05:50 instead of 06:00. Excellent guys put boxes in lounge and pointed out which box had instructions. Opened box with instructions got my breakfast and read instructions. I would recommend at least 2 people for assembly. Boxes and contents are very well made and very heavy. Instructions say build in 4 hours, took us one day but we got spring adjustment wrong. Reset springs as per instructions and everything was perfect. Only regret...

review.content: The wall bed is of good quality and the opening and closing mechanism works well and safely. We’re very pleased with the final outcome , but it a big job to assemble. Took up most of a weekend. It’s mostly hard because the panels are heavier than the standard IKEA stuff you get. I would advice you having some good help and as much space as you can to assemble it . Some of the instructions are very precise.

review.content: With working from home I wanted to change our spare bedroom into a multi use space and this bed was the perfect way to do so. Once built the bed feels very robust and has a high quality finish, but be warned that it is a hard unit to build. My partner is very good with this type of thing as used to do it as a job and even he found the instructions hard to follow, and found some of the alignments for screws slightly out which made things frustrating. There was also some bolts missing, but Arthaus...

We bought it for the spare room...

Having said that the bed is good quality and looks great. The catch that hold...

review.content: A great end result with a challenging journey. Cannot be installed too close to a side wall or you won't be able to finish the installation (in particular the external screw that holds the bed to the wall). Think carefully on how you will attach it to the wall. On carpet at least, you're very likely to need shingles to correct the shape. Still, once completed, it's a very nice piece. Not far in quality from a custom job.

review.content: Excellent!! Perfect for the small space we have! We was expecting it to be difficult to put together after reading previous reviews but was fairly straight forward although extremely heavy when put together. Hardest part was getting the springs on and correct as we didn't have the right tool. I would 100% recommend this product and company. Courier was really helpful and got a text the day before for an hour delivery window and was on time. It does 3 people to put together but my partner did it ...

review.content:
Excellent quality unit, lengthy but straightforward instructions. If you identify and mark/label all the parts before you start, this speeds things up later.
Couple of errors in the instructions and the wall bracket to cabinet fixing isn't sufficient with just 2 bolts. I backed this up with four screws. Otherwise all good.
Bank on a full day to complete if you do it methodically.
Great end result.

Advise you read instructures well, follow to the latter, do ...
